ranking_note: Authored from the before description at commit 4803086565, frozen before the rewrite; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. Competitors are the same-plugin tool-definition audit (mcp-tools:audit), the settings and MCP config correctness audit (harness-config:audit), the effective permission report (harness-config:audit-permission-state), and the mod inventory (harness-ops:audit-mod-posture), which shares the posture vocabulary, and the ~/.claude install inventory (harness-ops:audit-install-state).

queries.request: Half my MCP servers launch with npx and no version. Can you check which ones aren't pinned?
List every MCP server Claude Code would start on this machine, with where each one is configured and how it's launched.
I'm worried one of my MCP packages could get swapped for a malicious release. How exposed am I?
Which of my MCP servers run as local processes when the vendor also offers a hosted URL I could use instead?
Who actually publishes the MCP servers in my user and project config? I want to know if any come from random accounts.
Do a security posture pass over the MCP servers I've got set up, without starting any of them.
There's an MCP config file bundled inside a plugin I installed. Fold it in too and tell me if those servers pull a moving tag like latest.
Give me a dated inventory of my MCP servers I can diff next month to see what changed.
Is there a Docker image for any of my MCP servers that I'm ignoring in favor of running the npm package directly?
Review the tool descriptions in my MCP server code and tell me which parameters lack docs.
My GitHub MCP server shows as failed in /mcp and won't connect. Is my .mcp.json wrong?
Which allow and deny rules are actually in effect across my settings files right now?
Run npm audit on this web app and tell me which dependencies have known CVEs.
What mods are installed in my Claude Code, and is the built-in security guard active?
Should the delete_record tool in my server set destructiveHint, and is readOnlyHint right on the list tools?
Check my settings.json and hooks for drift against the current Claude Code docs.
Our Python service's requirements.txt has unpinned packages. Can you pin them and check for typosquats?
Why is my ~/.claude folder several gigabytes? Show me what's taking the space.
